thread:
mira: deploy-bot just flagged a p95 regression during the v2.5 canary in US-W. It9s recommending an auto-revert. Can someone with rollback rights decide?
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +24% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold exceeded. Suggested action: trigger-auto-rollback. [telemetry link]
engina: Oncall for the window. Are we seeing 5xxs or user errors, or is it pure latency?
mira: No 5xx spike, only latency on /embeddings and a small uptick in KV cache miss rate after kernel change.
lee: If errors are flat, full revert seems heavy. Can we do a traffic-slice pin for embeddings back to v1.4.8 instead?
kyle: We have routing controls. We can pin embeddings to previous binary for 30% of traffic then ramp if it helps.
ops-bot: POLICY: Partial routing pins during change windows require manual approval from an oncall engineer + release owner. Please ack to proceed.
engina: I approve manual partial pin for embeddings. Mira, you own release notes. Lee/Kyle please execute.
lee: Running command now: ```rwctl route update --service embeddings --target-version 1.4.8 --scope 30% --ramp=2m --reason "canary p95 spike"```
lee: routing update submitted, ramping 30% -> 100% over 2m if stable.
deploy-bot: ACTION: routing change applied (embeddings -> 1.4.8, scope 30%). Telemetry watch started.
kyle: p95 for embeddings dropped ~19% within 60s for pinned slice. KVcache miss reduced for that slice.
mira: Good signal. Continue ramp to 100%.
lee: Completed ramp to 100% over 2m. All embeddings traffic now on 1.4.8.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary p95 now within baseline. Auto-revert suppressed due to manual intervention.
engina: Nice. No customer-facing errors reported in CS tickets. Mira, can you prepare a short blurb for customers? Include that we paused rollout and rolled back embeddings binary while we investigate kernel mismatch.
mira: Draft: "We observed increased latency for embeddings requests during a staged rollout. We rolled back embeddings routing to the previously stable binary (v1.4.8) and paused the rollout. No user-facing errors were reported. Engineering is investigating a kernel/path interaction causing cache misses. We'll share an update once root cause is confirmed."
kyle: Add: "Next steps: reproduce in staging with same kernel flags, collect KVcache profiles, and run a focused perf test."
mira: Added. Posting to #release-notes and notifying customer success.
engina: Great. Closing thread unless someone raises objections.
ops-bot: RECORD: action logged. Manual partial rollback executed by lee; approved by engina. Incident state: mitigated.
